contract: Return a preview with the replacement label. The input draft's label must stay unchanged. The draft has a writable, enumerable own data property called `label` that holds a string. The `nextLabel` argument is a different string.

Return a progress object whose `completed` count advances by one when `accepted` is true and stays unchanged when it is false. The input progress object has an enumerable own data property called `completed` holding a nonnegative safe integer below `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. Zero is represented as `+0`. The `accepted` argument is a boolean.
